The `#{tenantId} IS NULL OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}` fallback defeats the stated goal of this change ("显式租户条件…跨租户清库收口"). In MySQL `NULL IS NULL` evaluates to TRUE, so when `tenantId` is null the OR-branch short-circuits and the statement becomes `DELETE FROM biz_score_participant WHERE period = ?` — i.e. it physically wipes ALL tenants' participant lists for that period. Callers can and do pass null: `ScoreService` line 232 passes `GroupScopeUtil.currentGroupOrNull()`, which returns null both for the platform admin and for a non-admin whose group cannot be resolved (see `GroupScopeUtil` javadoc: "取不到任何集团归属 → null, 调用方必须按 fail-closed 处理(空结果/拒绝)"). Because the mapper cannot distinguish those two cases, a fail-closed situation is silently converted into the most destructive possible cross-tenant delete, and this also bypasses the MyBatis-Plus tenant interceptor (which is deliberately disabled when `aigicrm.tenant.enable=false`, as the entry-mapper comment notes). Recommend making the null case fail-closed (delete nothing) and letting callers that legitimately need a cross-tenant/admin cleanup use a separate, explicitly named method, e.g.:

